en.title: Killer Targets Corrupt Developers in Barcelona Thriller 'Carro Seco'
en.summary: A chilling new thriller is set to grip audiences as a mysterious killer begins to target unscrupulous real estate speculators in Barcelona. French production company Halley Production has officially boarded the project, titled 'Carro Seco.'
en.body:
Barcelona's glamorous facade is about to crack. A new feature film, **Javier Polo**'s **Carro Seco** (which translates to 'Dry Cart' or 'Empty Cart,' hinting at the hollowness of its targets), is poised to deliver a potent dose of suspense. The project has just secured backing from Paris-based **Halley Production**, signaling significant international interest in this dark, character-driven thriller.

Set against the vibrant backdrop of Spain's second-largest city, **Carro Seco** centers on a vigilante killer with a very specific — and arguably justifiable — set of targets: the unscrupulous real estate speculators who exploit the housing market. This isn't just a story about murder; it's a narrative that looks set to dissect the greed and corruption festering beneath the surface of urban development, promising a cathartic, albeit violent, reckoning for those who profit from others' misfortune.

The film is being showcased at the upcoming **Iberseries & Platino Industria's Co-Production and Financing Forum** in Madrid, a key event for industry professionals looking to discover and invest in new projects. **Halley Production** is joining forces with **Los Hermanos Polo Films**, run by **Javier** and **Guillermo Polo**, and Barcelona-based **Lastcrit**, forging a strong European partnership to bring this timely story to life.

## A Reckoning for the Ruthless

The premise of **Carro Seco** taps into a universal frustration with unchecked capitalism and the often-devastating impact it has on communities. In cities around the world, the actions of real estate developers can lead to gentrification, displacement, and a widening gap between the wealthy and the working class. **Javier Polo**'s thriller appears to confront these issues head-on, offering a fictional outlet for the anger and disillusionment many feel when faced with predatory development practices. The killer's methodical targeting of these speculators suggests a narrative that is as much about justice, however twisted, as it is about suspense.

## What the Industry is Watching

For fans of intelligent thrillers that offer more than just jump scares, **Carro Seco** represents a promising new voice in European cinema. The involvement of **Halley Production**, known for backing compelling and artistically driven projects, suggests that **Javier Polo**'s vision will be realized with high production values and a keen eye for detail. The film's appearance at the **Iberseries & Platino Industria** forum indicates it's already generating buzz within the industry, positioning it as a potential standout at future festivals and a must-watch for cinephiles seeking thought-provoking genre fare.

## What's Next

While specific production timelines and casting details for **Carro Seco** have not yet been announced, its boarding by **Halley Production** and showcase at **Iberseries & Platino Industria** strongly suggest that development is well underway. Audiences can anticipate further updates as the film moves closer to production, with a potential release in 2026. Keep an eye on these industry events for more concrete news regarding this exciting project.
